    • ascW

      public static Integer ascW(String s)
      Returns the Unicode code of the first character of a string. Like in VBA, the result is a 16-bit integer, so codes above 32767 are negative.

    • chrW

      public static String chrW(Integer code)
      Returns the character with the given Unicode code. Negative codes down to -32768 are taken as 16-bit integers, as AscW returns them.

    • dateDiff

      public static Integer dateDiff(String intv, Timestamp dt1, Timestamp dt2, Integer firstDayOfWeek) throws UcanaccessSQLException
      Returns the number of interval boundaries between two dates, like Access. For example, the difference in minutes between 00:00:59 and 00:01:00 is 1, and the difference in weeks (ww) counts the first days of the week in between. Only the interval w counts whole periods of seven days.
      Parameters:
      intv - interval: yyyy, q, m, y, d, w, ww, h, n or s
      dt1 - first date
      dt2 - second date, the result is negative if it is before the first date
      firstDayOfWeek - 1 for Sunday to 7 for Saturday, 0 for the default locale, only used for ww
      Returns:
      number of intervals, null if an argument is null
      Throws:
      UcanaccessSQLException - on an invalid interval or first day of week

    • partition

      public static String partition(Double number, double start, double stop, double interval) throws UcanaccessSQLException
      Returns the range of the given size, like "11: 20", into which a number falls.
      Parameters:
      number - number to find the range for, if null, null is returned
      start - start of the overall range, at least 0
      stop - end of the overall range, greater than start
      interval - size of each range, at least 1
      Returns:
      range of the number, padded to the width of the largest value
      Throws:
      UcanaccessSQLException - if start, stop or interval are invalid
